trajectory.title: 末端实际与参考轨迹
trajectory.caption: World XY/XZ paths of the actual flange and the recorded live reference, only while the approach reference is applicable. Equal spatial scales. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

tracking.title: 末端轨迹跟踪误差
tracking.caption: Actual flange minus the recorded live reference during approach: world position components, position norm, and SO(3) rotation error. No inactive post-latch reference is extended. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

reference_progress.title: 参考进度与治理候选
reference_progress.caption: Virtual path time in seconds, virtual-time rate, acceleration and selected candidate. A red x means no verified candidate, not an accepted zero-speed command. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

state_estimation.title: 状态估计误差与测量年龄
state_estimation.caption: Geometric-origin estimation errors at valid estimator-output ticks. Shading is the maximum of three marginal 3-sigma values, not joint coverage or a safety certificate. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

capture_and_load.title: 实际捕获量与接口载荷
capture_and_load.caption: Independent physical capture quantities and actual load. Dashed pose lines denote capture gates; dotted post-latch lines denote holding gates. Values are not corrected by subtracting numerical residuals. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

detumbling.title: 世界与相对角速度
detumbling.caption: Target world and target-base relative angular-speed norms. The fixed final two-second window is shaded only for completed full-horizon runs. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

momentum_energy.title: 动量、能量与功
momentum_energy.caption: Separate linear/angular momentum drift, kinetic/relative energy and integrated work. Momentum and actual safety quantities retain their original SI definitions. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

joints.title: 七关节状态与实际力矩
joints.caption: All seven joint positions, velocities and actual actuator forces from the saved physical trajectory. Line style and color identify each joint. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

geometry.title: 碰撞距离与接口几何
geometry.caption: Original and added robot-clearance pairs, other target pairs and intended interface contact are shown with their separate original thresholds. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

identification.title: 影子惯性辨识
identification.caption: Shadow posterior parameters and finite-data rank; evaluation-only truth is dashed in the matching component color. The logarithmic singular-value display floors values below 1e-12; this floor is not measured excitation. Parameter feedback remains disabled. Numerical rank is not parameter accuracy or control benefit. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.

base_motion.title: 被动基座漂移与角速度
base_motion.caption: Passive-base translation and geodesic attitude change relative to its initial pose, followed by world angular-velocity components. No base actuator is introduced. Run R04_V2_H1; COMPLETED; actual interval 0.000–27.932 s; latch 7.932 s; final window EVALUATED. All runs are seen development/regression.
